newsitem.title: FRANCE: French cabinet to name new GAN boss - paper.
newsitem.headline: French cabinet to name new GAN boss - paper.

text.p: The French cabinet is expected to remove GAN chairman Jean-Jacques Bonnaud by decree on Wednesday and name Didier Pfeiffer, vice chairman and managing director of UAP, as his replacement, French newspapers said.
The government called on Bonnaud last week to resign from GAN after saying he failed to promote the privatisation of GAN bank unit CIC but Bonnaud has refused to step down.
La Tribune daily said Pfeiffer had the backing of the chairmen of insurance groups Axa and UAP.

"In making this choice, the government entrusts GAN to an insurance professional expected to take up the challenge of the privatisation of the company and of its banking subsidiary," the newspaper said.
Government officials were not available for comment.
